summary.text: Krystyne Knutson is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Jordan Rasmusson (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small-business owner, community advocate and nonprofit founder and leader.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Krystyne Knutson said her work centers on strengthening rural communities, supporting young people and families, and protecting individual rights.
She named affordability and rural opportunities, health and human services, and education and strong communities as her three key campaign messages.
Among her policy interests, she listed healthcare and mental healthcare access, public education and early childhood development, affordable housing and childcare, and disability access.
